## Professional Summary
WASH professional and data analyst with 3+ years’ experience in governance, service delivery, and supporting efforts at accelerating progress towards safely managed and climate-resilient WASH. Skilled in coordinating multi-stakeholder processes, managing donor-funded programmes, and leveraging data, statistical analysis, geospatial analysis, and modelling to strengthen decision-making, improve policy alignment, and enhance service outcomes across rural, urban, and emergency contexts.
